description: Local, deterministic, fixture-based benchmark for the Evidence Layer v0.1. No live calls. Evidence statuses and the evidence-constrained final answer are regression signals over scripted fixtures, NOT truth guarantees. Each case sets confidence/reviews/challenge identically so that the ONLY variable distinguishing outcomes is the attached evidence.

cases.question: Does spaced repetition improve long-term retention?
cases.claim_text: Spaced repetition improves long-term retention compared with massed study.

evidence_fixtures.summary: Controlled study: spaced groups outperformed massed groups at 30-day recall.
Independent replication reports the same direction of effect.

cases.question: Do learning styles (visual/auditory/kinesthetic) improve outcomes when matched?
cases.claim_text: Matching instruction to a learner's preferred learning style improves outcomes.

evidence_fixtures.summary: Meta-analysis finds no benefit from matching instruction to learning style.

cases.question: Does background instrumental music help studying?
cases.claim_text: Listening to background instrumental music helps studying.

evidence_fixtures.summary: Small, mixed survey suggests some learners feel more focused; inconclusive.

cases.question: Does a 20-minute nap before studying improve encoding?
cases.claim_text: A 20-minute nap immediately before studying improves memory encoding.
